assumptions.criteria: link feasible if margin >= 3 dB above min detector signal; thermal feasible if neighbor < 68C (VO2) in nominal/worst duty-cycle cases

G3.label: Duty-cycled PCM writes + isolation + TEC assist

H1.label: Strict OMCC sequencing + vertical/lateral isolation + manifold cooling

H4.label: Aggressive sequencing + high-capacity spreading/manifold + active stabilization

assumptions.layout_duty_sweep: layout_factor and transient_rise factors with duty sweep for PCM candidates (conceptual, not FEM)

candidates.name: Open WDM-PCM (A1+G1+B3)
candidates.notes: Thermal dominated by PCM writes near rings/VO2; relies on trenches, spreading, TEC and OMCC sequencing.

candidates.name: Thin-film membrane/F-P stack (EO-tuned)
candidates.notes: No 300C PCM write; thermal load mainly EO/RF drivers and stabilization, manageable with spreading.

candidates.name: Thin-film membrane stack (PCM+EO hybrid)
candidates.notes: Localized PCM write heat co-integrated with EO; requires isolation/trenches and duty-cycled writes.

recalibrated.scenario: Duty-cycled PCM writes + isolation + TEC assist

candidates.name: Membrane-Brush NV (A1+G3+3D)
candidates.notes: 3D stacking increases path/crossings and thermal density; segmented heaters, vertical/lateral isolation and strict sequencing required.

recalibrated.scenario: Strict OMCC sequencing + vertical/lateral isolation + manifold cooling

candidates.name: Volumetric Tensor Membrane (G2/G3+F2+A1)
candidates.notes: Highest optical path complexity and distributed thermal load; needs high-capacity spreading/cooling and active stabilization.

recalibrated.scenario: Aggressive sequencing + high-capacity spreading/manifold + active stabilization
